documents_expected.why: grant types, typical amounts, area, who can apply, rolling process

eligibility.rule: Projects and organisations in or near the Yorkshire Dales National Park or Nidderdale National Landscape
eligibility.quote: Projects and organisations must be within the Yorkshire Dales National Park or Nidderdale National Landscape, or close to their boundaries.

eligibility.rule: Open to public bodies, community groups, charities, social enterprises, individuals, landowners, farmers and businesses
eligibility.quote: We welcome applications from public bodies, voluntary and community groups, social enterprises, charities, partnerships, young people, individuals, landowners, farmers and businesses.

eligibility.rule: Project delivers at least one of YDMT's aims: people, landscape or wildlife
eligibility.quote: help us to deliver at least one of our three aims

effort.step: Contact the Grants Officer to discuss the idea
effort.quote: To discuss your project idea, please contact our Grants Officer

effort.step: Apply any time; decision within six weeks of complete information
effort.quote: Applications can be submitted at any time. We aim to give you a decision within six weeks of us receiving all of the necessary information.

notes: Project Grants and Unrestricted Grants (which can pay rent, insurance, staff and travel). Typical grants £1,000–£5,000, no set minimum or maximum. Woodland creation and hedgerows go to the separate Woodland Grants. The page publishes no form, document list or reporting duties; the gather's other three documents were a tree-gift FAQ, terms and conditions and a privacy policy.
